messages:
marta: Heads-up — bringing skylark-embed-v1 to staging for onboarding. Did a first-pass semantic similarity + clustering sweep. Short queries (<6 tokens) look noisy, posting quick notes. :eyes:
ryan: Can you paste the recall numbers?
marta: Sure, pasted the run below (ran on 2k holdout, default negatives):
```
model: skylark-embed-v1
eval_set: holdout_2k_short_queries
k: [1,5,10]
fp16 -> recall@1: 0.61, recall@5: 0.82, recall@10: 0.88
int8  -> recall@1: 0.52, recall@5: 0.75, recall@10: 0.81
mean_norm_fp16: 1.12
mean_norm_int8: 1.00
note: big drop concentrated on queries len<=5
```
noah: Oof, ~9pts drop at @1 is sizable. Did you try per-channel quant or clamp settings?
sophia: Also curious if whitening/length-norm mismatch vs prod ref is driving this. What's prod-ref right now?
marta: Prod-ref is cedar-embed-v3 for this workload. I did a quick distance shift check: short-query centroids shifted ~0.18 cosine vs cedar. UMAP looks like small clusters collapsed toward center for int8. Link: https://redwood.internal/umap/1768887777-snapshot (staging)
bharat: Can you share the eval command you used? want to reproduce.
marta: Ran: `python eval/recall.py --model skylark-embed-v1 --dataset holdout_2k_short --neg-samples 50 --quant int8 --batch 128`
ryan: I'll run knn-sanity (k=1,5,10) and also check recall stratified by query length and by token overlap. Posting results in ~20m. :thumbsup:
sophia: Quick thought — some models change embedding norm distribution; if downstream uses cosine vs dot it matters. Try mean-centering + length norm before KNN to compare apples->apples.
marta: Did a tiny experiment: applying whitening trained on prod-ref reduces int8 gap from 9pts -> 4pts at @1. So calibration seems to help.
bharat: That suggests quantization calibration / per-channel scale could fix. Try perchannel-int8 + 2k calibrationsamples. Also check symmetric vs asymmetric clamp.
noah: Also check negative sampling: if negatives in eval are mostly long docs, short queries may suffer. Try hard negatives.
marta: Agreed. Action plan: run per-channel quant calibration (+symmetric/asymmetric), run holdout sweep with hard negatives and longer calibration set, and compare post-whitening. I'll open a quick ticket and attach these results.
ryan: I'm on knn-sanity now. If I see anything weird I'll drop a minimal repro notebook here.
deploy-bot: staging-deploy | skylark-embed-v1 -> deployed on staging pool gpu-a3 (id: stg-342) :rocket:
sophia: If per-channel fixes it we can re-run int8 CI and then a small canary on dedicated. If not, we might need a small fp16 fallback for short-query routes.
marta: Thanks — tagging owners: @ryan (knn sanity), @sophia (quant calibrations), @bharat (calib config), @noah (eval negative sampling). I'll follow up with ticket ID in ~1h. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
ryan: noted.
marta: Closing loop here for now — will post updates in thread as runs finish. Thanks! :pray:
